resources.string: Recording the places you visit · Manage in Settings
Timeline uses your location to record the places you visit and the journeys between them, even when the app is closed or not in use. It stays end-to-end encrypted on your own devices.
Physical activity lets Timeline count your steps, which is what tells a bike ride apart from a run. Without it, cycling is usually recorded as running.
Timeline needs precise location to record the places you visit. Approximate location cannot tell one place from the next, so recording stays off.
Keep recording after the app closes

Timeline collects your location to record the places you visit and your trips, even when the app is closed or not in use. Android stops Timeline in the background from time to time; to start recording again on its own, it needs location access set to “Allow all the time”.\n\nWithout it, recording resumes only when you next open the app. Your timeline stays end-to-end encrypted on your own devices.
